scope: Precise paragraph glyph origins connected to deduplicated monochrome outline resources and integer interval Bezier bounds. Independent placement/extrema checks and diagnostic SVG previews. Not production rasterization, complete Draw IR or target-app visual acceptance.
artifactSizeScope: Incomplete development artifacts only. No full kernel distribution, timing/memory benchmark or Musterwork desktop installer estimate.

independentGeometryReport.scope: Independent Fraction line placement and analytic polynomial extrema of emitted quantized paths; no independent shaping, rasterization, fill/stroke/effect ink or target app visual acceptance.

diagnosticPreviews.scope: Diagnostic unhinted monochrome SVG paths from core scene, no text nodes, fonts, scripts or external resources. The viewer supplies rasterization; this is not production rendering/Office comparison.

visualInspection.renderer: macOS Quick Look, not the kernel paint backend
visualInspection.observation: Full path placement visible without clipping after fixed-square diagnostic viewport. No target application comparison or pixel-quality gate claimed.

limitations: Scene supports only unhinted monochrome nonzero-filled glyph paths. Color-table presence blocks scene publication pending per-glyph color representation selection. Missing outlines and unresolved layout likewise do not yield a partial scene.

Bounds cover the locus of quantized path segments, not filled/stroked/effect ink or raster coverage. Move-only paths have no bounds; degenerate segments can have zero-area bounds. Arc/conic paths, group transforms, brushes, images, clip and effects remain future work.

Core bounds use outward integer intervals and explicit tolerance. The independent analytic checker uses 120-digit Decimal with 1e-80 raw-Q32 comparison epsilon; this checks the corpus, not a complete formal proof.

Source font curves already use HarfBuzz design64 quantization. Q32 placement does not restore earlier precision. Output numbers are canonical raw i128 Q32 strings with semantic range validation, not JSON floats.

Selected outlines batch per font/axis instance in chunks of at most 256 unique glyphs. Chunks may upload the same font again; persistent font handles, production cache eviction and comprehensive performance/memory acceptance are incomplete.

Current scene limits are 64 selected font instances, 4096 unique source glyphs, 262144 source commands, 262144 scaled commands and 2097152 path/bounds work nodes, with subdivision depth 64. A valid document can exceed this profile and fails explicitly.

The preview generator is diagnostic SVG serialization using actual evaluated paths; macOS Quick Look performs its rasterization. It is not a production core renderer or an editable document export and is not a substitute for the planned CPU/GPU backend.

Fault evidence is an actual WASM outline allocation failure after successful layout/metrics, and unit cancellation checks. It does not claim exhaustive new native fault injection or production host lifecycle coverage.
Existing geometry/paragraph APIs do not retain the additional precise-origin array. They share the extracted Q32 implementation and remain corpus-identical.
Complete presentation model compilation, advanced editable objects, animation/media playback, Office/WPS acceptance, Agent product interfaces and Musterwork E0-E3 replacement gates remain incomplete.
